name: Extinction
description:
• Slain entities are marked for [dark-red]extinction[/dark-red], permanently granting [effect:stack][dark-gray]1 stack[/dark-gray][/effect]. Strikes deal +0.25 hearts damage per stack against that entity type, up to +[effect:hearts][dark-gray]5-10 ❤[/dark-gray][/effect].

  • Only one entity type can be marked at a time. A new type can be marked by gaining 5 [dark-red]extinction[/dark-red] stacks against it.

effects.explanation: Bosses grant 4 stacks and, at max level, the bonus damage to them is uncapped. Stacks have no effect in Trials.
